purpose: Homepage revision for multiple scoring scenarios
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium Chinese product design board for FunBox MULTI-SCENARIO scorekeeping WeChat mini program. This is a revision correcting an over-mahjong-themed home page. Landscape 1536x1024. Crisp readable Simplified Chinese, clean ice blue #f5f7fa background, cobalt #2d5bff, white cards, deep navy, small coral accents. Restrained softly rendered 3D porcelain visual language. ONE enlarged full home screen on the left, and a concise product design explanation with scalable scene card examples on right. No device frame, subtle rounded screen outline, clear WeChat navigation/capsule and mobile status bar. Lots of whitespace. Title across top "首页属于所有牌局" small eyebrow FUNBOX / HOME V2. subtitle "公共记分语言，场景各有主题".
LEFT MAIN MOBILE HOME SCREEN:
FunBox cobalt wordmark upper left, small subtitle 好友记分, guest pill upper right. Compact hero taking only about 20% of mobile height: headline 好友相聚，\n每局都算数。Small supporting line 选个玩法，轻松开一局. Right of headline a SMALL neutral 3D scorecard with +8 and −8 and a blue checkmark, no dice, no mahjong, no poker, no green tabletop, no plants. Hero may have pale blue abstract circle only, most space for the app's functions.
Section 选择牌局 and small caption 不同玩法，一样清楚.
Two vertically stacked equally sized WHITE scene cards with equal padding and illustration size, both about 100 logical pixels tall:
Card 1 left tiny pale green square icon containing two SMALL mahjong tiles with red 中 and green circle pattern (only this card can have mahjong art), main 麻将记分, below 4 人牌局 · 给分与结算, green small 已开放, trailing chevron.
Card 2 left tiny pale coral square icon containing SMALL poker cards A and K, main 炸金花, below 轮流加注 · 实时看池, muted gray 敬请期待. Card retains same hierarchy as first, slight muted state, no interaction arrow suggesting available.
Under them current existing 记分原则 card with three concise rows: 01 只记录给分，赢家无需重复加分; 02 一次可给多位玩家批量提交; 03 房主确认结算，统一生成输赢.
Bottom small green dot 牌局服务正常; tabbar 首页 selected, 我的 neutral. Keep all visible in full phone screen, never fill home with a game table. No future scene placeholders on the actual homepage.
RIGHT EXPLANATION:
Top white large rounded panel label "01 首页：统一的记分入口". Show three small generic porcelain score tiles "+8", "−8", "✓" and text "积分牌 · 好友 · 同一套按钮与布局". Tiny blue caption "主视觉不绑定任何一种玩法".
Below white rounded panel "02 场景：主题留在卡片和内页". Two equal card samples side by side: jade accent 麻将 with small tile and coral accent 炸金花 with small poker art. Each arrow points to a small respective internal screen header; jade 老友局 / 麻将记分 and coral 好友牌局 / 炸金花, mark latter 主题示意 · 暂未开放. Note "公共外壳一致，专属元素按场景切换".
Bottom panel "03 扩展：加场景，不重画首页". Show a neutral outline template card with square icon placeholder, text 场景名称 / 人数与规则摘要 / 状态. Three succinct token labels "图标" "主题色" "规则". Note "新增玩法沿用同一卡片；场景增多后再增加分类". Avoid invented available games, fake chat, statistics, recent rooms, search and filters on the CURRENT home. A single footer "设计修正版 V2 · 首页去麻将化，麻将内页保留主题". Visually polished actionable interface, not an infographic overloaded with text. Keep coherent and legible.
